methodology: Fresh canister per case, implementation and trial. configure runs separately before four forced GC increments. One synchronous operation is measured using performanceCounter(0), rts_total_allocation and rts_reclaimed. Output serialization/checking executes after the counters in a separate query; expected bytes are independent oracles. Cumulative allocation includes transient allocation and synchronous GC; end-of-message GC is excluded. No empty-loop subtraction. Each implementation is separately compiled; Wasm sizes are total canister artifact sizes.

cases.name: api-secp256k1-publicKey-ecdsa
cases.notes: Byte-oriented composition of pinned ecdsa@8.0.1 APIs. Input decoding, strict length/range validation, operation, SEC1/DER/compact serialization and array-to-Blob conversion are measured. Only reusable curve construction and immutable input literals are outside timing. Fixture comes from the independent frozen curve oracle; no plugin outputs were used. Typed error text differs from the native API; comparison is for this valid input. The pure Motoko key multiplication is variable-time; this is a mathematical output comparison and does not assert the native secret operation and this reference have equivalent side-channel properties.
